feeds.title: A bad witch's blog
feeds.description: I am Lucya, I'm a witch. A blog about paganism, witchcraft and the day-to-day experiences of a witch living in the UK.

feeds.title: SpookyMrsGreen
feeds.description: I am Catherine Green, ghostbuster, author, mother and wife. My ghosts lurk within the human mind; my supernatural creatures are loud and proud. SpookyMrsGreen is about pagan housewife: Mindful parenting, ethical consumerism and modern pagan lifestyle.

feeds.title: Rachel Patterson Blog
feeds.description: Rachel Patterson has been a witch for ages, but not the spooky kind with green skin and warts! Her craft is a mix of different traditions like old religion witchcraft, Wicca, wild witchcraft, kitchen witchery, green witchery, and folk magic. Deep down, she's a Kitchen Witch at heart.

feeds.title: Damh the Bard
feeds.description: Damh the Bard is a modern-day Bard whose spirituality and love of folk tradition is expressed through his pagan music, storytelling and poetry. Drawing on the Bardic tradition, his performances are both entertaining and educational, speaking directly to the heart, and never without a good splash of humor.

feeds.title: Pagan Hare's Witchcraft Blog
feeds.description: This blog is for all things that I care to share that is witchcraft and pagan orientated including my app oracle cards and my own related memes.
